# T2.2 — Reload settings when the config file changes

## Spec

Watch the config file and re-parse on change. A parse failure keeps the last
good settings rather than reverting to defaults.

## Scope

The watch loop and the swap. No new settings.

## Acceptance

- Editing the file takes effect without a restart.
- A malformed edit is logged and ignored; the daemon keeps running on the last
  good settings.

## Note

`open`, but not eligible: T2.1 is not `done`. It counts toward
`ready --count` (work remains) and not toward `ready --count-eligible` (what can
start now). Completing T2.1 puts this on the frontier automatically on the next
query — nothing needs to be requeued.
